system.description:
3rd Level Clan Feature

Mutated Feature: Swirling Seals

Lacking the distinct Fuinjutsu mastery of the once famous Uzumaki Clan, you instead manifest an oppressive, dominant willpower to push through, and persevere through any situation. This manifests itself as additional Spiral Cells. You gain 2 additional Spiral Cells. This instead becomes 4 additional Spiral Cells at 11th level. You gain additional uses for these Spiral Cells meant to reinforce your fortitude. Once per turn, you can perform any of the following;

When you would make a saving throw or ability check to end a condition currently affecting you, you can spend 1 Spiral Cell to gain a rank of Mastery to that check or save.

When you would take damage, you can spend your reaction and 1 Spiral Cell to gain DR equal to your level against the triggering creature, until the beginning of your next turn.
